About.title: Software Developer, Project Lead & Teaching Assistant
About.bio1: Experienced Software Developer, Project Lead, and University Teaching Assistant based in Tripoli, Libya. I specialize in cross-platform mobile development with Flutter, full-stack web applications with Next.js and React, and software architecture using Clean Architecture and OOP principles.
About.bio2: As the founder of Octobits and lead developer behind live commercial platforms in Libya including Mutah.ly and Addidi.ly, I have managed end-to-end product development, from frontend implementation and staging pipelines to production deployment and team leadership.
